newsitem.title: USA: Granite State to acquire Primary Bank.
newsitem.headline: Granite State to acquire Primary Bank.

text.p: Granite State Bankshares Inc and Primary Bank said on Tuesday that Granite agreed to acquire Primary Bank in a stock swap merger that would form a bank with $807 million in assets.
Each share of Primary would be converted into 0.9951 shares of Granite State Bankshares, subject to adjustment based on Granite's closing price, the companies said in a joint statement.
Primary would be valued at $25.25 per share, based on Granite's price of $25.375 a share at 1200 EDT on April 29, 1997, the companies said.
Granite State has an option to acquire 12.9 percent of Primary Bank's common stock under certain circumstances, the companies said.
The companies said they anticipate $4.5 million in pretax expanse savings from consolidation opportunities and the deal will be accretive to earnings per share and book value in the first year.
Granite State will post a $4.4 million charge to cover transaction costs when the deal is completed, the companies said.
The exchange ratio for conversion of Primary common stock into Granite State shares remains fixed, unless Granite's stock rises above $27.28 a share or falls below $25.375, the companies said.
If Granite's common stock falls below $20.30 a share, Primary has the right to terminate the agreement unless the exchange ratio is increased, the companies said.
The exchange ratios will be adjusted to reflect Granites' three-for-two stock split to be effective on May 9, 1997, the companies said.
